caveats: variance screen on all samples, shared by nulls
interpretation: NOT a biomarker claim. AUC 1.0 at n=18 with p=2000 features is the classic small-n overfitting signature: fold sizes of 3-4 and variance screening on all samples make perfect separation trivially achievable. Reported as a CALIBRATION CASE for the audit framework: naive reading would claim a perfect blood biomarker; the audit flags it as non-credible. This cohort is too small to contribute a signal estimate.
